job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

- Take ownership of the architecture design and development of scalable and distributed software systems, ensuring performance and reliability.
- Translate complex business requirements into technical specifications and guide the team in the implementation of these specifications.
- Lead the technical execution of projects, ensuring high standards of code quality, adherence to project deadlines, and efficient resource allocation.
- Design, develop, and deploy LLM-based pipelines involving patterns like RAG and agentic workflows to enhance AI solutions.
- Oversee the complete software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, coding, testing, and deployment, with a focus on achieving product goals.
- Utilize cloud services from AWS, Azure, and GCP to enhance system capabilities and ensure robust infrastructure support.
- Implement DevOps practices using tools like Docker and Kubernetes to ensure seamless continuous integration and delivery.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, conduct code reviews, and provide guidance on software design and best practices, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence.

Overview

- As an AI LLM Engineer Manager at a leading consulting firm in Bangalore, you will lead a team of talented engineers in the development of advanced AI solutions.
- Your role will involve designing scalable architectures and ensuring the performance and reliability of AI-driven systems.
- You will leverage your expertise in LLM solution development to collaborate with cross-functional teams, providing strategic technical guidance and spearheading innovation.
- You will play a pivotal role in translating complex business requirements into effective technical solutions, driving the adoption of cutting-edge technologies in the consulting sector.
- The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, with significant experience in LLM and traditional machine learning solutions.
- You will utilize your extensive knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and GCP, along with DevOps tools, to enhance our software development lifecycle.
- Your leadership will be crucial in managing the complete software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis through to deployment, ensuring the highest standards of quality and efficiency.
- Working in a hybrid mode from Bangalore, you will join a dynamic and innovative environment where your contributions will directly impact the success and growth of our client solutions.
- Your role involves a blend of hands-on technical work and leadership, guiding your team to achieve strategic objectives and meet client expectations.
- In this role, you will also focus on implementing best practices for software engineering and DevOps, ensuring continuous integration and delivery.
- Your ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and effectively to a diverse audience will be essential in fostering a collaborative team environment and driving the continuous development and delivery of AI solutions in the consulting sector.

Requirements

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
- At least 7 years of experience in software development, with a minimum of 1-2 years in LLM solution development.
- Proficiency in Python and JavaScript, with strong coding skills and experience in API frameworks such as FastAPI and Django.
- Extensive experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS, Azure, or GCP, and DevOps tools including Docker and Kubernetes.
- Strong knowledge of LLM patterns like RAG, Vector DB, and agent development, with experience in using LLM APIs and SDKs such as OpenAI and Langchain.
- Experience with Agile methodology and software engineering practices, including version control (GIT) and DevOps workflows (Azure DevOps preferred).
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts effectively to a diverse audience.
